meta.title: Central Fitness Club
meta.description: Central Fitness Club at Hotel Central Sarajevo: a gym over three floors, group classes in an air-conditioned studio, a heated 25-metre pool, sauna, steam bath and caldarium.

title: Feel
your power
hero.intro: A gym over three floors, group classes and a 25-metre pool, in the centre of Sarajevo.

gym.label: (01) The gym
title: Everything
under one roof
body: Treadmills, stair climbers, ellipticals, bikes and rowers; free weights, kettlebells, dumbbells and strength machines — in two air-conditioned fitness studios over three floors.
Whether you are a complete beginner or train every day, our trainers will help you get started and keep going.

classes.label: (02) Group classes
title: Train
together
classes.body: Classes for every age and fitness level take place in our air-conditioned group exercise studio — from yoga and Pilates to HIIT, kettlebell and indoor cycling.

pool.label: (03) Pool & wellness
title: Swim, then
slow down
pool.body: Swim lengths in the heated 25-metre pool, then relax in the Finnish sauna, steam bath and caldarium — a gentle 40–50 °C sauna with heated benches — and cool off in the plunge pool.

title: Join
the club
join.body: Ask us about membership, a first visit or a tour of the club. Call reception or write to us — we will gladly show you around.

hours.label: (04) Opening hours
title: Opening
hours
hours.fallback: Club opening hours are being confirmed. For today's hours, please call {phone}.

meta.title: Central Fitness Club
meta.description: Central Fitness Club u Hotelu Central Sarajevo: teretana na tri sprata, grupni treninzi u klimatiziranom studiju, grijani bazen od 25 metara, sauna, parna kupelj i caldarium.

title: Osjetite
svoju snagu
hero.intro: Teretana na tri sprata, grupni treninzi i bazen od 25 metara, u centru Sarajeva.

gym.label: (01) Teretana
title: Sve na
jednom mjestu
body: Trake za trčanje, stepperi, eliptični trenažeri, bicikli i veslači; slobodni tegovi, girje, bučice i sprave za snagu – u dva klimatizirana fitness studija na tri sprata.
Bilo da ste početnik ili trenirate svaki dan, naši treneri pomoći će vam da započnete i istrajete.

classes.label: (02) Grupni treninzi
title: Trenirajte
zajedno
classes.body: Treninzi za sve uzraste i nivoe kondicije održavaju se u našem klimatiziranom studiju za grupne vježbe – od joge i pilatesa do HIIT-a, treninga s girjama i spinninga.

pool.label: (03) Bazen i wellness
title: Plivajte, pa
se opustite
pool.body: Plivajte u grijanom bazenu od 25 metara, a zatim se opustite u finskoj sauni, parnoj kupelji i caldariumu – blagoj sauni od 40–50 °C sa grijanim klupama – i rashladite se u bazenu za hlađenje.

title: Postanite
član
join.body: Pitajte nas o članarini, prvoj posjeti ili obilasku kluba. Nazovite recepciju ili nam pišite – rado ćemo vam sve pokazati.

hours.label: (04) Radno vrijeme
title: Radno
vrijeme
hours.fallback: Radno vrijeme kluba je u fazi potvrđivanja. Za današnje radno vrijeme nazovite {phone}.
